youtube._help: Free tier: 10,000 quota units a day. search.list costs 100 units, channels.list 1 per 50 channels; channel RSS feeds (activity and business contacts in video descriptions) cost nothing. A query is a string (most relevant first) or {"q": ..., "order": "date"} (newest first).
